# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Norato Design System Foundation

**Purpose**: Validate that the planned UX, UI, accessibility, token, and component requirements are complete and unambiguous.
**Created**: 2026-08-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Authority and Scope

- [x] CHK001 Is the authority order between Material Design, Figma, Norato tokens, and Tailwind explicit and contradiction-free? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK002 Is the Light Mode v1 boundary explicit, including what dark mode does not cover? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003B]
- [x] CHK003 Is the legacy guide clearly separated from approved v1 requirements? [Conflict, Plan §Research]

## Typography Requirements

- [x] CHK004 Are Vazirmatn and Estedad roles unambiguous for body, headings, titles, labels, and controls? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003A]
- [x] CHK005 Are every approved font family, weight, and size traceable to Figma node `8773:27429`? [Traceability, Spec §FR-003C]
- [x] CHK006 Is the exclusion of Lalezar explicit wherever the Figma source still lists it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003D]
- [x] CHK007 Are line-height, letter-spacing, text scaling, and localization expansion requirements defined for each typography role? [Gap, Completeness]

## Layout and Responsive Requirements

- [x] CHK025 Does the form-section requirement define shared title left-edge alignment, shared field right-edge alignment, and an exact 12px inter-block gap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 Is the 4-unit spacing base and 8-unit primary rhythm defined without conflicting component exceptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002A]
- [x] CHK009 Are Compact, Medium, Expanded, Large, and Extra Large behaviors specified beyond naming the width classes? [Gap, Clarity]
- [x] CHK010 Are breakpoint-boundary, narrow-landscape, zoom, keyboard/IME, and long-content scenarios included? [Coverage, Plan §Quickstart]
- [x] CHK011 Are readable content widths, gutters, and alignment axes measurable for wide windows? [Measurability, Plan §Research]

## Component and State Requirements

- [x] CHK012 Does every interactive component contract require semantic purpose, anatomy, variants, and composition boundaries? [Completeness, Plan §Component Contract]
- [x] CHK013 Are default, hover where applicable, pressed, focus, selected, disabled, loading, error, empty, and success states scoped per component? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are immediate versus transactional interactions defined for switches, forms, and action controls? [Clarity, Plan §Research]
- [x] CHK015 Are recovery paths specified for validation errors, loading failures, empty states, and interrupted actions? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Does the shadcn evaluation requirement define when customization is sufficient and when a custom primitive is justified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]

## Accessibility and RTL Requirements

- [x] CHK017 Are target size, contrast, focus visibility, keyboard behavior, accessible names, roles, and states specified without relying on color alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK018 Are RTL alignment, reading order, focus order, icons, mixed Persian/Latin content, and localization expansion explicitly covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK019 Are reduced-motion and text-scaling requirements defined without fixed-height text clipping? [Accessibility, Plan §Quickstart]
- [x] CHK020 Are drag/swipe-only interactions required to have keyboard or button alternatives? [Gap, Plan §Quickstart]

## Cross-Framework and Token Contracts

- [x] CHK021 Is CSS custom property output defined as the canonical contract for Vue, Next.js, and plain HTML/CSS? [Clarity, Plan §Structure]
- [x] CHK022 Is Tailwind explicitly constrained to consume semantic tokens rather than introduce local design values? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008A]
- [x] CHK023 Are parity requirements defined for equivalent component contracts across all supported environments? [Completeness, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK024 Does every token and component contract include a source reference and an objective verification method? [Traceability, Plan §Data Model]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they require correction or a later decision.
- This checklist validates requirement quality, not implementation behavior.
